items.title: Correction: only Das and Ranka got 5-day judicial custody — Ajinkya Shinde released on personal bond
items.summary: LiveLaw (published 9:01 AM IST, updated 9:07 AM IST Oct 14) reports the SEM court's custody order in the Oct-13 Jantar Mantar 'trespass' case: Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka remanded to 5 days' judicial custody; Ajinkya Shinde was released on personal bond — NOT sent to Tihar. This corrects the earlier ~9:00 AM IST alert, which relied on early IG news graphics (SAAM TV, VOB) that described all three leaders as getting 5-day judicial custody. Two other categories independently report the same split outcome: Bar & Bench's 03:51:14Z 'BREAKING NEWS' IG graphic headlines only Das and Ranka being sent to 5-day judicial custody, and India Today's live stream is titled 'CJP Leaders Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka Sent To Tihar Jail' — neither names Shinde for custody. Context: FIR for alleged trespass/unlawful assembly/disobedience after Jantar Mantar's de-notification; trio detained Tue AM, held at Jaffarpur Kalan, moved to Parliament Street ~3 AM, produced at SEM Mandir Marg this morning.
